messages:
nora: Hey team — baby via gestational surrogacy arrived yesterday! Need to add to benefits but BC lists carrier. What proofs do you accept?

sasha - People Ops: Congrats! :tada: For surrogacy we accept either: court parentage order, or hospital birth letter + surrogacy/intent agreement as provisional docs, or an amended birth certificate later. Upload to HR portal (Benefits > Dependent Docs) and pick category 'Newborn - Surrogacy'. Link: https://hr.redwood.example.com/upload

kevin: If court order takes >60 days, can we still get retro coverage?

sasha - People Ops: Upload provisional docs within 60 days from DOB to add as a QLE. We can provisionally enroll and process retro premiums once final docs arrive. After 60 days we can submit a carrier exception but not guaranteed.

nora: Payroll/proration question — how does mid-month enroll affect premiums?

sasha - People Ops: Premiums prorate from the effective date; deductions show on the next payroll. We'll confirm effective date when you submit. DM me if you want priority review.
